title: Žaġręn · R02 62项历史词形—现代音变许可逐格检查
purpose: 验证三词族、六条已存在音变对62个历史格位的适用性并逐格说明现代变格仍待独立验证。

protection.pointOfReview: 词干音变许可≠历史格尾在现代继续存活。

rules.establishedLaw: 历史 /tʲr/ > /tʰr/；新增字母 ṱ = /tʰ/，区别于 ť、t
rules.sourceCaveat: 仅该音丛起源，不把所有t变送气
rules.allowedScope: only the previously enumerated lexical family and phonological environment

rules.sourceCaveat: 先验证此辅音丛，不影响全部r
rules.allowedScope: only the previously enumerated lexical family and phonological environment

rules.establishedLaw: 词首 /sne/ > /sę/（鼻音失去辅音地位，元音鼻化）
rules.sourceCaveat: 也可作用于复合词词根的起始位置
rules.allowedScope: only the previously enumerated lexical family and phonological environment

rules.establishedLaw: 词首 /sne/ > /se/，失去鼻音但不保留鼻化
rules.allowedScope: only the previously enumerated lexical family and phonological environment

rules.establishedLaw: 历史软音节尾触发 /o/ 前化为 /ø/，后经类推推广到全词干
rules.sourceCaveat: 词干音变；不能见软音就无条件换字
rules.allowedScope: only the previously enumerated lexical family and phonological environment

rules.establishedLaw: /gn/ > /ŋ/ 写ң；旧 ogon 经次音节脱落 ogn 再同化
rules.sourceCaveat: 保留相关词汇历史层级，不得无根据把单独g或n写作ң
rules.allowedScope: only the previously enumerated lexical family and phonological environment
